relationships.subject: dexmedetomidine
relationships.evidence_quote: DEX epidural preconditioning can inhibit the activation of TLR4 and the activation of downstream key signals IRF3 and P65 in rat spinal dorsal horn

relationships.subject: dexmedetomidine
relationships.evidence_quote: The expressions of IRF3, P65, and phosphorylation in W4, W5, and W6 groups were significantly lower than those in group W2 (p < 0.05).

relationships.subject: dexmedetomidine
relationships.evidence_quote: Dexmedetomidine epidural anesthesia pretreatment could significantly inhibit visceral pain response in rats with functional chronic visceral pain

key_findings: Epidural DEX pretreatment reduced visceral pain behavior and EMG responses in rats with functional chronic visceral pain, dose-dependently.
DEX lowered spinal dorsal horn TLR4 mRNA and IRF3/P65 expression and phosphorylation.
